start.text: Elias? ...I knew the city would drag you back eventually.

choices.text: I need to talk. Something happened to Jonah.
Someone searched your garage. What are you hiding?

jonah.text: Jonah came here two nights ago. He asked about an old set of keys. Then somebody came looking for the same thing.

choices.text: I'll keep you out of this. Tell me what you know.

pressure.text: You disappear for years, come back angry, and start asking questions like you still own this place? No. Slow down.

choices.text: You're right. I should have asked first.
Fine. I'll find the answers somewhere else.

keys.text: Old ignition keys. They belonged to a delivery van tied to Black Mile. Jonah said one of them opens a storage cage.

end.text: Behind the railway yard. And Elias... don't make me regret helping you again.
